reuse.why: Takes its category set from the existing getMonthWideCategories selection and reads prior-month spending through getSheetValue/sheetForMonth, mirroring the other month-wide actions; batchMessages, setBudget and mutator(undoable) are reused.

duplication.why: Repeats the income-skip check (is_income && !isTrackingBudget) and the expense sign flip that each month-wide action already inlines, instead of sharing them.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts beside its siblings and is registered in budget/app.ts with the same mutator/undoable wrapping.

scope.why: Only the new action, its handler type/registration and tests are added.

maintainability.why: Small and consistent with the sibling actions, though the per-action income rule and sign handling keep growing as copies.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getMonthWideCategories and setBudget like the existing actions.

disguised_duplication.where: The income-skip and sign-flip lines are copied openly in the same shape as set3MonthAvg, not disguised.
